description: Angular component for displaying and managing details of persistent RPC requests, including delete functionality and data binding.

classes.name: PersistentDetailsDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for viewing and deleting persistent RPC requests.

methods.name: loadPersistentFields
methods.description: Populates form fields with data from a PersistentRpc object.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, returning whether the persistent request was updated.

methods.name: deleteRpcRequest
methods.description: Deletes the persistent RPC request after user confirmation.
